debrief db-021
1) the actor m-e-r-g-e-d the a-c-c-e-s-s c-o-n-t-r-o-l r-e-c-o-r-d-s into a s-h-a-d-o-w l-o-g-s-t-o-r-e to m-a-s-q-u-e-r-a-d-e the o-r-i-g-i-n-s and l-e-f-t b-e-h-i-n-d a f-o-r-g-e-d i-d-e-n-t-i-f-i-e-r w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n
2) the actor c-o-p-i-e-d the c-a-m-e-r-a f-e-e-d-s to a p-l-u-g g-i-v-e-n d-e-v-i-c-e to b-y-p-a-s-s the b-i-o m-e-t-r-i-c c-h-e-c-k-s and l-e-f-t b-e-h-i-n-d a r-o-w v-i-d-e-o c-l-i-p w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the t-i-m-e-s-t-a-m-p s-y-n-c r-e-v-i-e-w
3) the actor f-a-k-e-d the b-i-o m-e-t-r-i-c m-o-d-u-l-e o-u-t-p-u-t to t-r-i-g-g-e-r a g-r-e-e-n s-t-a-t-e and l-e-f-t b-e-h-i-n-d a m-o-d-i-f-i-e-d s-o-f-t-w-a-r-e b-l-o-b w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y h-a-s-h c-o-m-p-a-r-i-s-o-n
4) the actor r-e-t-r-a-c-e-d the e-n-r-o-l-l m-e-n-t f-l-o-w via a f-a-k-e c-a-r-d r-e-g-i-s-t-r-y e-n-t-r-y and l-e-f-t b-e-h-i-n-d a c-l-o-n-e-d b-i-o m-e-t-r-i-c p-r-o-f-i-l-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the d-u-a-l f-a-c-t-o-r a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-a-t-i-o-n
5) the actor c-l-e-a-r-e-d the r-a-w s-e-n-s-o-r b-u-f-f-e-r-s to h-i-d-e the t-r-a-c-e and l-e-f-t b-e-h-i-n-d a c-o-r-r-u-p-t-e-d s-y-s-t-e-m j-o-u-r-n-a-l w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the f-o-r-e-n-s-i-c i-m-a-g-e c-a-p-t-u-r-e
